messages:
Alex M.: FinEdge just returned a custom security assessment and they're asking for: KMS/HSM audit-log schema + example exports, HSM attestation proof, and a root-cause + repro for the 401 auth spike that also caused a billing overage. They want a response by 2024-11-03 EOD. Need eng + SRE + compliance help to assemble artifacts.

Jordan (Eng): Can you paste the exact questions they sent? For KMS logs we currently emit: key_id, request_id, principal, operation, result, latency_ms, and hsm_attestation_ref. Are they asking for a specific schema/version?

Alex M.: Pasting customer's excerpt: 
• Please provide the audit log schema for KMS and HSM exports (field names, sample row).
• We need the signed HSM attestation report and how to verify it.
• Provide timeline, request_ids, and repro steps for 401s on 2024-10-28 that coincided with a billing spike.
• Confirm what redacted artifacts you can share and expected delivery date.

Jordan (Eng): OK. We can generate a redacted JSON sample for the schema. For attestation, we publish signed reports; those are safe to share. Production traces: need Security Ops approval before sharing raw traces. Do we have the request_ids/times?

Sara (CS): They included two trace ids in the ticket: 01-abc123def and 01-ghi456jkl. Occurred 2024-10-28 15:12:33 UTC and 2024-10-28 15:14:02 UTC. They reported 401s with error message 'invalid signature' across token exchange and /v1/predict endpoints. Billing team also flagged an unexpected token-metering charge spike.

Mike (SRE): I checked metrics: auth token verification latency spiked ~15:09–15:20 UTC and error rate (401) increased from 0.2% -> 3.8%. Correlated increase in ingress requests (burst) at the same window. Saved graph and will export a timeline. Link (internal): https://redwood.monitoring/graphs/dashboard?span=2024-10-28T15:00:00Z~2024-10-28T15:30:00Z

Jordan (Eng): Can I get the full request log rows for the request_ids (redacted PII) so I can inspect signature headers and token flows? If possible paste a minimal curl example that reproduces the failing header set.

Alex M.: Customer sent this repro snippet (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/predict \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>" \
  -H "x-request-id: 01-abc123def" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' 
```
They say same token works intermittently.

Jordan (Eng): I'll try to replay the exact headers against a staging-ish environment. If the token verification path fails under load we might have a caching edge-case or a sig-verifier race. I'll instrument and reproduce.

Alex M.: For the KMS/HSM schema question, customer expects a csv/json sample and explanation of each field (timestamps in ISO8601, request_id, principal, operation, result, error_code, hsm_attestation_ref).

Jordan (Eng): We'll produce a redacted sample JSON and include the schema doc. For HSM attestation we can provide the signed PDF. @CompliBot: confirm which artifacts are OK to share with customers without a formal DPA amendment.

CompliBot: Automated notice: Allowed artifacts for external sharing without additional contracts: redacted audit logs (remove PII and token values), HSM attestation report (signed, no secret keys), high-level architecture diagram. Full production traces and raw token values require Security Ops approval. See policy: https://redwood.internal/policies/sharing-audit-data :lock: 

Mike (SRE): I'll prepare: (1) redacted request log export for the two request_ids; (2) timeline and metric screenshots showing latency/error-rate correlation; (3) billing spike CSV showing charge breakdown. I can have the artifacts ready by EOD tomorrow (2024-10-31).

Sara (CS): Suggest we respond with: (A) schema + redacted sample logs (attached), (B) signed HSM attestation (attached), (C) timeline + preliminary root cause + mitigation steps, (D) invitation to share traces under Security Ops approval if they need deeper forensic data. Anyone object? :thinking_face:

Jordan (Eng): Fine by me. I'll prioritize repro today and post findings and a PR if a code fix is required. If it looks like a tokensigning race, I can try a hotfix for staging and schedule a patch.

Alex M.: Assigning owners: Jordan = repro + code investigation, Mike = metrics/logs + billing correlation, Sara = customer communications & coordinate Security Ops approval. I'll draft the reply and circle back once CompliBot confirms allowed artifacts. :thumbsup:

Sara (CS): Draft reply posted to the ticket (snippet):
"Thanks for the report — we can provide redacted audit logs, the signed HSM attestation report, and a timeline of events. We're investigating the 401 spike and will share repro steps and mitigation notes by 2024-11-03 EOD. If you require full production traces, please confirm and we'll request Security Ops approval.

Attachments: redacted-kms-logs.json, hsm-attestation-2024-10.pdf, auth-timeline-2024-10-28.png"

Mike (SRE): I'll upload the redacted exports to the secure share and add links to the ticket once ready.

CompliBot: Automated: To proceed with sharing production traces, create a Security Ops request at https://redwood.internal/security-ops and reference ticket FINEDGE-2024-451.

Alex M.: Thanks all. I'll hold sending the response until Mike uploads artifacts and Security confirms. Marking this thread as in-progress — will close after customer reply sent.

Sara (CS): Noted. Will follow up with customer if they ask for an earlier ETA. :calendar:
